purpose: Resolve the one Campaign012 concept into one exact and finite no-value mechanism. This audit freezes formula, direction, timestamp and lag grid, high-low ordering, zero-range, informative-pair, correlation-degeneracy, and endpoint semantics, rejects alternatives, and challenges the mechanism against all 35 prior terminal mechanisms before any external minute partition, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return is opened.

mandatory_sequence_and_range_challenges.distinction: Campaign011 is invariant to permutations of its 240 range magnitudes because it measures their unordered distribution. Campaign012 explicitly changes under within-half permutations and measures only lag-one sequence memory.

mandatory_sequence_and_range_challenges.distinction: Campaign010 uses adjacent intervals' price-level intersection and union spans. Campaign012 discards interval price levels after forming each log range and correlates only successive range magnitudes.

mandatory_sequence_and_range_challenges.distinction: The terminal amount-profile mechanism sequences traded CNY activity. Campaign012 forbids amount and volume and sequences direction-neutral price-range magnitudes.

mandatory_sequence_and_range_challenges.distinction: The terminal factor distributes squared between-close returns without using their lag correlation. Campaign012 reads no close, uses within-bar high-low ranges, and freezes a lag-one reversal statistic.

candidate.name: intraday_intrabar_range_reversal_238p
candidate.economic_hypothesis: When a direction-neutral one-minute range shock is followed by compression rather than another large range, transient intraday uncertainty may dissipate instead of clustering and carrying into the next-open-to-third-close holding interval.
candidate.formula: -PearsonCorr(x_i, y_i) across 238 within-half adjacent pairs, where x_i=log(high_t/low_t) and y_i=log(high_(t+1)/low_(t+1)); morning and afternoon each contribute 119 pairs and no lunch pair is formed
formula_steps: Require the exact accepted 241-row source grid, preserve but exclude the standalone 09:30 row, and select exactly the 240 bars at 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00.
Require every selected high and low to be finite and strictly positive with exact raw ordering low_i <= high_i. Do not round, clamp, sort, repair, or apply a tolerance.
For each selected bar compute range_i = log(high_i/low_i). Require every range to be finite and nonnegative.

Within the 120-bar morning half form its 119 consecutive ordered pairs (range_t, range_(t+1)); independently form the same 119 pairs within the afternoon half. Concatenate the two pair arrays in chronological order. Never form a lunch transition.
Define an informative pair as one where x_i > 0 or y_i > 0. Require at least 120 informative pairs; retain zero-zero pairs in the fixed 238-pair correlation arrays rather than dropping them.

Compute population-centered Pearson correlation over all 238 x/y pairs: sum((x-mean(x))*(y-mean(y))) divided by sqrt(sum((x-mean(x))^2)*sum((y-mean(y))^2)). Do not rank, standardize by half, weight, winsorize, or use sample-degree corrections.
Require both centered sums of squares and the denominator to be finite and strictly positive. A constant lag or lead array makes the factor missing; do not substitute zero.
Set the factor to the negative correlation so higher is frozen as faster lag-one range reversal. Canonicalize only endpoints within 1e-12 of -1 or +1; do not otherwise clip or transform.
candidate.timestamp_semantics: Use exactly 238 one-minute adjacent pairs internal to the two continuous trading halves. Exclude 09:30, the lunch transition, overnight values, and any cross-day or cross-stock pair.
candidate.zero_missing_denominator_semantics: Zero-range bars remain in the fixed 240-bar sequence and zero-zero pairs remain in the fixed 238-pair correlation arrays. Fewer than 120 informative pairs, any invalid/nonpositive/nonfinite high or low, any low-above-high ordering violation, a nonfinite range, zero/nonfinite lag or lead variance, or a zero/nonfinite correlation denominator makes the stock-day missing.
candidate.correlation_estimator: population-centered Pearson correlation across the concatenated fixed 238 within-half pairs
mechanism_distinction_before_values: Campaign011 depends only on the unordered distribution of the 240 range magnitudes and is invariant to their permutation. Campaign012 is a lag-one ordering statistic and can differ under any within-half permutation with the same Campaign011 entropy.

Campaign010 compares adjacent high-low interval price levels through overlap and union. Campaign012 uses only the scalar magnitude log(high/low); translating bar price levels without changing range magnitudes leaves Campaign012 unchanged but can alter Campaign010.
Amount-profile persistence sequences traded CNY amount. Campaign012 forbids amount and volume; identical range sequences can have different amount sequences and vice versa.

Realized volatility, volatility resolution, diffusive variation, return variance entropy, semivariance, sign runs, and close paths require successive closes. Campaign012 is invariant to close placement conditional on the high-low range sequence.
rejected_variants_before_values: Spearman, Kendall, rank, sign, mutual-information, run-length, partial-autocorrelation, higher-lag, multi-lag, autocovariance, regression-slope, ratio, total-variation, absolute-difference, transition-bin, or half-specific variants
dropping zero-zero pairs, adding epsilon, replacing a degenerate correlation with zero, normalizing each half separately, cross-lunch pairing, including 09:30, or using another time support
